title: Rav Ika of Pashrunya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 104a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.104a.6), posing a contradiction to Rava. Hyman reports the Yuchasin reading, cited in Dikdukei Soferim from a manuscript, as Rav Ika bar Chanina.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Eruvin names Rav Ika of Pashrunya and does not give his father’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=459&lang=en) includes Chanina in his headword but observes that this Eruvin passage omits it. Hyman cites the patronymic from Yuchasin through Dikdukei Soferim.
